diagnosis: The consultation locking endpoint checks session.is_locked and raises ConsultationLockedError prior to validating whether clinician is authorized to treat the patient associated with consultation_id. The custom exception handler exposes sensitive psychiatric assessments and restricted prescription plans in the 423 error body.
